reasons: With a maximum of 4 MC per semester, the student can take only one 4-MC course per semester. From Y3S1 through Y4S2 there are only 4 semesters available, but the student must still take 6 mandatory 4-MC courses: CS4261, CS4278, CS2105, CS2102, CS3219, and CS4350.
CS4278 also requires CS3263 or CS3243; CS3243 is blocked because CS2109S is already completed, so CS3263 would need to be added as a prerequisite, making the load at least 7 courses.
Therefore the remaining degree cannot be completed within semesters 5-8 under the 4 MC per semester limit.
